description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeSalaryDao, testing various CRUD operations and data retrieval related to employee salary management within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDaoTest
classes.description: Test class for EmployeeSalaryDao, includes setup and multiple test cases for CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeSalaryDao, and populates test data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests saving an employee salary record without direct debit.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalaryWithEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Tests saving an employee salary record with associated direct debit information.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests deletion of employee salaries by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalariesBulk
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of multiple employee salaries.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Retrieves specific employee salary records and asserts their properties.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee salaries based on filter parameters and orders.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employee salaries matching filter criteria.
